lines.text: Someone on a short ladder is scrubbing a shop window. Squeak. Squeak.

lines.speaker: window_washer
lines.text: Don't look in the glass. You'll see somebody awake, and that's bad for business.

lines.speaker: window_washer
lines.text: You again. I had to wash your face off three windows last night.
You hold the bucket steady. The water smells like nothing at all.
You wipe the top corner. Your reflection squeaks away.

lines.speaker: window_washer
lines.text: Not a reflection left on the street. Nice work, kid.
The Window Washer folds the ladder and stomps off.
In the window, you can see yourself. Nobody washed the reflection out.
